verdict.rationale: QuickBooks docs describe bank connections importing transactions, matching, reconciliation completed 'in minutes', and discrepancy/missing-checks/reconciliation reports to review issues, which together cover matched/unmatched/discrepancy review for reconciliation. However, evidence is entirely vendor-sourced with no independent hands-on confirmation and no explicit mention of a 'duplicate transaction' flag. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the reconciliation workflow, explicit documentation of duplicate-transaction detection UI.
